extension.name: SMTP Relay
extension.description: Send large CiviMail mailings through a second SMTP route (an SMTP relay or bulk provider) while all other mail keeps using the default outbound route. Rules, shadow mode, and authentication without credentials (IP), with a password, or by reusing the OAuth token of oauth_outgoing_mail.

compatibility.comments: Semantic versioning. For example, compatibility with "6.1" implies compatibility with "6.2".

php_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "8.1" and "8.2".

smarty_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "4" and "5".

extension.comments: Developed for Stichting Onvergetelijke Zomerkampen (NL). Default mode is off: installing changes nothing until you configure a rule and switch to shadow or on.
